targets.title: Every Trader Faces Losses, Even The Best Ones 🫡 #trading #lossintrading #profit #viralshorts #viral
targets.author: The Market Duo
targets.text:
One of the biggest myths in trading is that a good trader never faces losses. But the reality is completely different.
Even experienced traders face losing trades. What separates a good trader from others is the ability to minimize losses when trades go wrong and maximize profits when trades go right.
Successful trading is not about winning every trade; it's about managing risk, maintaining discipline, and making smart decisions.
